macros.name: py
macros.doc: Executes (object-like) <code> and writes its string representation to the document.

macros.name: pyfile
macros.doc: Executes the Python file specified by <path>.

macros.name: pyfileq
macros.doc: Executes the Python file specified by <path>. Any output to the document is suppressed.

macros.name: pyif
macros.doc: Evaluates the Python boolean expression <test>, and then executes either the LaTeX code in <then clause> or the LaTeX code in <else clause>.

macros.name: pyq
macros.doc: Executes (object-like) <code>. Any output to the document is suppressed.

macros.name: pysession
macros.doc: Sets <name> globally as Python session for subsequent Python code.

envs.name: python
envs.doc: Executes the provided block of Python code.
